checkIn.capability: CronCreate with recurring true, the cron expression and the prompt that the schedule command prints; the job is session-scoped, so it ends with the coordinator's session
checkIn.remove: CronDelete with the recorded job id
checkIn.tracking: The desktop app pauses an idle session when free memory runs low, unless it tracks a live recurring job of that session; it tracks a job only when it saw the creation in the session's live stream, so a restart or resume of the session's process loses the tracking while the job keeps firing. A tracked job may also be dropped after about 3 days (unconfirmed), so the job is re-armed every 2.

claude.selfCheck: the command line that started your claude process carries --model, --effort and --permission-mode, and CLAUDE_EFFORT in your own shell reports the effort
claude.turns: Your process exits when your turn ends, and only the coordinator resuming your session with its answer starts it again. Never end a turn waiting on a background task, a reviewer journal or CI: wait in the foreground inside one tool call (a polling loop on the journal or output file with a bounded sleep), or repeat foreground checks within the same turn. End a turn only for a decision request to the coordinator, a blocker or completion, each sent by message first.

claude.mechanism: SendMessage with to set to that session id

codex.unsupported: a Claude session cannot message a Codex thread

codex.selfCheck: the latest turn_context row of your rollout reports the model and effort

claude.unsupported: a Codex writer cannot message a Claude session

reportFallback: the coordinator reads the end of your transcript at each periodic check-in

retiredRoutes.claude-desktop: a desktop session starts only in a turn the user's own message began, and an unattended coordinator has none
retiredRoutes.claude-adopted: the app resumes an adopted session at its own default effort and permission mode, and raising the mode shows the maintainer an approval card an unattended coordinator cannot answer
retiredRoutes.claude-agent: an Agent-tool writer ends with the coordinator's session, so an unattended run would lose it
